canada.title: 97-year-old's tribute to Terry Fox among quilts on display at St. John's event
canada.summary: A grand display of craft work is on now through Saturday at the Anglican Cathedral of St. John the Baptist in St. John's.

canada.title: British Columbians vote in early election, with David Eby’s job on the line
canada.summary: VICTORIA - British Columbians go to the polls today in an early election called by NDP Leader David Eby in the biggest gamble of his political life.

canada.title: It's crunch time in Ottawa's election. Here's how the mayoral front-runners plan to win
canada.summary: With just one weekend left before Ottawa voters head to the polls, mayoral front-runners Neil Saravanamuttoo, Alex Lawson, Jeff Leiper and Mark Sutcliffe are strategizing about how to make the best of it.

canada.title: For these Niagara renters, jobs, housing and transit are top of mind this municipal election
canada.summary: Property taxes and promises to keep them as low as possible have been central to the municipal election campaigns of many local candidates, given they're a priority among Niagara residents. But for renters in the region, other issues are top of mind.

canada.title: Duelling petitions highlight rift over paroled murderer at McGill law school
canada.summary: Students at McGill University's law faculty remain divided over the presence of a convicted murderer in the classroom, with a new counter-petition outlining why some students feel unsafe and don't want him in their presence.

canada.title: 82 days later, no repairs started on washed-out road dividing small Quebec town
canada.summary: Residents in L’Ascension, Que., are still waiting on repairs after August flooding washed away part of their main road. The municipality's mayor blames the delay for repairs on the bureaucracy of different levels of government.

canada.title: Manitoba government drops plan to limit new autism strategy to children
canada.summary: The Manitoba government is withdrawing amendments to a Liberal MLA's bill that would have made a new provincial autism strategy only apply to children.
